name: repolens
description: RepoLens – AI-powered repository understanding and developer onboarding tool

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors bgBlue,bgGreen "python -m uvicorn backend.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
